senses.definition: n.pr.loc. Is 30:4 in Lower Egypt, on island in Nile, S. of Memphis (‖ צֹעַן) = Egyptian Ḥnnstn [Ḥnénsĕ], Assyrian Ḫininši; Herodot. ii. 137 Ἄνυσις, afterward Heracleopolis magna, now Ahnâs; v. SteindorffBAS i, 602.
